user.title: EG.D OpenAPI Setup
user.description: Enter your Distribuce24 portal credentials and EAN of your supply point.

history.title: History Start Date
history.description: Select the date from which you want to download historical consumption data.

reconfigure.title: Update Credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter your new EG.D OpenAPI credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to EG.D API.
error.invalid_ean: Invalid EAN. Must be exactly 18 digits.

abort.already_configured: This supply point is already configured.

auth_failed.title: EG.D API Authentication Failed
auth_failed.description: Failed to download data due to invalid credentials. Your Client Secret has likely expired. Please go to the integration settings and click Reconfigure.

fetch_history.name: Fetch history from EG.D
fetch_history.description: Immediately forces downloading historical data from Distribuce24 servers. Can be limited to a specific supply point and a start date.

start_date.name: Start date (optional)
start_date.description: Date from which to download data in YYYY-MM-DD format. If omitted, the last saved date is used.

remove_statistics.name: Remove statistics
remove_statistics.description: Completely wipe all downloaded EG.D statistics from the database and reset the checkpoint.

entry_id.name: Entry ID (optional)
entry_id.description: ID of the configuration entry to clear.

ean.name: EAN (optional)
ean.description: EAN of the supply point to clear.

init.title: Download Options
init.description: Set the time when the daily data download should occur and select data profiles.
